subject: Cross-functional handshake: MSA/DPA/order form dependency prioritization
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, James O'Connor <james.oconnor@aureliushealth.io>, Procurement Team <procurement@aureliushealth.io>
Date: Tue, 07 Dec 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Kickoff: sync on MAP sequencing and order-form cutover windows

Laura / Karthik —

Quick note to start aligning the mutual action plan with procurement's acceptance windows. Aurelius is asking for a tight cutover (targeting pilot sign-off by 2027-01-20) and they flagged two concerns: 1) DPA redlines that would push legal approval into week-of-signature, and 2) order form fields that block billing start until after a separate procurement workflow completes.

As we discussed, I want to propose a prioritized dependency list so we can:
- Lock items that must be included in the MSA before signature (SLA, data residency, indemnity)
- Allow the order form to be provisioned with provisional billing dates (to support pilot usage) while the procurement PO finalizes
- Stage the DPA negotiation after MSA signature for non-blocking items if possible

Can you two take a look at the attached MAP draft (Aurelius_MAP_v2.xlsx) and the dependency matrix (MSA_dependency_matrix.csv) and call out anything that absolutely cannot be slipped to the post-signature window? I want to capture that in the email to Aurelius by EOD tomorrow so their procurement team can see our proposed sequence.

Thanks — Tessa

--
Tessa Morgan
Senior Manager, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, James O'Connor <james.oconnor@aureliushealth.io>
Date: Tue, 07 Dec 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: sync on MAP sequencing and order-form cutover windows

Tessa — thanks for starting this. I reviewed the matrix and highlighted three MSA clauses we can't push past signature:
1) Section 5 (Customer Data Ownership) — procurement will sign only if this is explicit in the MSA.
2) Section 9 (Breach Notification SLA) — their security team requires a 24-hr notification commitment, note in MSA.
3) Indemnity carve-outs for IP infringement — legal insists we accept limited language but need to keep it in the MSA.

For the DPA: most operational controls (logs, subprocessor list) can be in a DPA post-signature if we include a binding timeline in the MSA (e.g., DPA to be executed within 30 days of MSA). That buys procurement enough to start provisioning.

On order form provisional billing: I'll approve a provisional billing start date in redwood's Order Form template, but we need a short clause that states billing is contingent on PO issuance within 60 days or charges will be credited — that reduces exposure.

I'll annotate the spreadsheet and return it. Once Karthik confirms sequencing for procurement approvals, we can send a single proposed MAP to Aurelius with two lanes: "Blockers (must-in-MSA)" and "Staged (MSA + post-signature tasks)."

Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Director, Sales
Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 08 Dec 2026 09:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: sync on MAP sequencing and order-form cutover windows

Thanks, Tessa and Laura — this is helpful. A few clarifications from procurement/security at Aurelius: 
- We can accept the idea of completing operational DPA items after MSA if Redwood puts a hard 30-day execution commitment in the MSA.
- The PO process is sequential in our ERP: finance will only issue a PO when the signed order form matches the internal budget code. Can Redwood provide a provisional order form with expected billing start and a billing-credit clause as Laura suggested?
- If indemnity/IP language remains a blocker, we will need a short call with your legal to negotiate a one-off carve. Eve (copied) will coordinate the redline.

Would appreciate a consolidated MAP PDF so procurement can circulate internally. James

--
James O'Connor
VP, Product & Partnerships
Aurelius HealthTech

Subject: Fwd: DPA redlines and proposed sequencing

Forwarding the initial redline notes so you can see what procurement/legal flags as time-sensitive. Attachment: DPA_redline_procura.pdf (summary):
- Requests for additional subprocessor transparency (we can agree to publish list within 14 days of full MSA signature).
- Request to change the data deletion SLA from 60 to 30 days (legal asks we accept 30 days in DPA).
- A small indemnity tweak requesting mutual indemnification for third-party claims tied to direct use; not a full IP carve.

If Redwood can commit to the 30-day DPA turnaround post-MSA and publish the subprocessor list within two weeks of signature, most of our concerns become operational rather than blocking. Happy to jump on a 30-minute call to work through language.

Eve

Thanks all — summary and next steps below (publishing to the shared Drive and attaching the MAP PDF for procurement circulation):

Summary of agreed sequencing (proposed):
- Immediate (must be in MSA): Customer data ownership; breach-notification SLA (24 hrs); indemnity baseline (limited carve).
- Near-term (signed MSA then within 30 days): DPA finalization (Procura redline addressed); subprocessor list publication (within 14 days); data deletion SLA acceptance (30 days).
- Order form: Redwood will provide a provisional order form with a provisional billing start date of 2027-01-25 and a billing-credit clause if PO is not issued within 60 days. This allows Aurelius to provision pilot access without revenue exposure.

Next steps / owners:
- Laura: finalize "must-in-MSA" clause language and send updated MSA excerpt by tomorrow noon.
- Karthik: confirm procurement flow/PO gating and whether we need our Finance to send a demo invoice template (ETA today EOD).
- Markus: prepare the MAP PDF and Drive link for Aurelius procurement circulation.
- Eve / Aurelius legal: circulate the redline DPA back to Redwood legal after your internal review (we will prioritize a 30-day turnaround).

If everyone's aligned I'll send the MAP + sequencing email to Aurelius procurement and copy our legal/finance. Please reply-all with any objections by 10:00am PT tomorrow; if silent I'll assume approval and proceed.

Thanks — Tessa

--
